shared_elements: low-relief carved figures on a flat stone panel
horizontal register or band dividing the composition
justification: Both are low-relief stone surfaces showing animals and figures with some register-like horizontal banding, but the specific content differs entirely: A is a narrative battle scene with a wheeled chariot, harnessed horses, an archer and fallen/naturalistically foreshortened human bodies among rosettes, while B shows isolated, static, schematic creatures (a quadruped above a crouching figure, a long-necked bird, a snake-like form) stacked in a non-narrative vertical arrangement with a row of arched motifs. The naturalistic, action-filled, overlapping figural style of A shares no conventions with the flat, emblematic, widely spaced silhouettes of B.
